a: Five-year hub awards that pay postdoctoral researchers and hub activities (travel, meetings, workshops), not PI or student salaries; NSF expects one hub per topic. Dollar size not stated.
dt: Open: the program page (updated Nov 16, 2026) lists participating topics (AMO theory, EPP/Cosmology theory, nuclear theory, plasma physics (nonlinear QED), QIS and PoLS, any topic in scope). Proposals go to the participating MPS Physics program under NSF 26-523, which accepts proposals anytime; contact the program first.
e: Hub awards for multi-investigator theory groups at US institutions, submitted through a participating MPS Physics program (AMO theory, EPP/Cosmology theory, nuclear theory, plasma physics, QIS or PoLS). Awards run up to five years and typically support 3 to 5 postdoctoral researchers.
n: NSF Focused Research Hubs in Theoretical Physics (FRHTP)
unv: Dollar size of awards not stated on the program page.
